v2.4.1.0 #03 (15-10-2026):
- Added Crucible Garage Shortcut and Sector 3 Garage Shortcut (by Gravity_Assist) (bring back the Crucible and Sector 3 banners in the garage when the game leaves them out)
- Added Colored Damage Stickers by OldSkool (colored hit marks on every graphics setting; in the Mod Menu you choose whether they show on your own tank, allies and enemies, or only on vehicles you hit)
- Updated XVM 13.1.0_0098
- Updated High caliber progress in the battle 1.2.0 by OldSkool (optional dark panel background with rounded corners instead of the transparency slider)
- Updated Armor Inspector wotinspector 4.5.3 and WOTInspector Heatmaps 1.0.9 (update for WoT 2.4.1.0)
- Updated The Old Battle Results Windows 1.0.9

current.changeLog:
- Updated HangMan Garage Manager 2.77 (your platoon mates' tanks are now also shown on garages made from battle maps and follow your tank when you move it; press TAB in the vehicle moving window to place their spots yourself; in Last Battle a tank destroyed in water or inside a building is now moved to the nearest free spot)
- Updated Colored Damage Stickers by OldSkool 1.0.2 (no longer active in event modes)
